segments.text: Your chat's running joke is now the boss.

Lore Boss turns repeated Twitch chat into a game. This is a real solo rehearsal. The model proposes a quote from two stored messages. A moderator inspects the exact evidence before anything reaches the overlay.
Approval stays human. Only approved lore powers the boss. The proposal becomes a quote attack, credited to the chatter who said it.
Spawn the boss, and chat takes over. The overlay and native Twitch chat are recorded together, with no separate chat track.
The approved line is now the boss's quote attack. Chat can attack, heal, or block. A lore strike is about to charge.
Block the strike. The stun doubles the next hit.
Heal restores five health. The final attack finishes it.
Thirty damage and one blocked strike, from real Twitch events.
Built with Codex and deterministic combat. This was a solo rehearsal; community testing comes next. Your community writes the story. Chat fights it.
